best_for: Aspiring Packaging Designers wanting industry-grade skills.
not_for: Those seeking passive lectures without project work.
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Beginners with no design software exposure.

overview.positioning: Physical product packaging design, dieline construction, material finishes, regulatory compliance, and 3D mockups.
overview.short_description: Intensive 2 Months program in Packaging Design.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Package case studies for your portfolio.

why_now.industry_shift: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands rely on shelf appeal and unboxing experiences to drive customer retention and viral social sharing.
why_now.ai_impact: 3D packaging preview engines and AI pattern generators streamline early unboxing concept testing before committing to costly print plates.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for specialized design skills in digital-first companies.
why_now.career_opportunity: Remote and freelance opportunities continue to grow for skilled designers.

learning_outcomes: ITERATE: Refine designs based on feedback and usability metrics.
DELIVER: Export production-ready files for clients or developers.

stages.focus: Learning the interface and core functions.

ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Final aesthetic judgment and quality assurance.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Manual review of all AI outputs.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Avoid copyright infringement with generated content.

common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always align to a consistent grid system.

career_paths.employer_expectations: A strong portfolio demonstrating process and final outcomes.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Ability to execute briefs from start to finish.

not_covered: Advanced 3D modeling and complex backend coding.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience in Packaging Design?
faq.answer: No, this course covers fundamentals to advanced techniques.

faq.question: Are software licenses included?
faq.answer: You will need to procure your own educational or student licenses.

faq.question: Can I use these projects in my portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes, all projects are designed to be portfolio-ready.
